headline: Weathered Expanse Holds Front as Nevish Line Quickens
war_summary: Three hours since the last edition, Nevish Line and Farranac Coast supply the fresh movement, each logging two changes in the last two hours, the former toward eight in the day at Tomb Father with seven Warden holds and one neutral outstanding, the latter toward two in the day at Transient Valley with all eleven bases Colonial-held, while Weathered Expanse remains the heaviest board with three late changes toward fifty-nine in the day around Spirit Watch, Frostmarch and Crow's Nest, now three Warden, four Colonial and two neutral. Marban Hollow has gone quiet in the last two hours after seven late changes, still thirty in the day at Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, and Olavis Wake, Kuura Strand, Pari Peak and Stlican Shelf likewise record nothing in the last two hours despite thirty, nineteen, twenty-seven and eight changes in the day. Linn Mercy and Gutter remain silent late, and Callahan's Passage, the Deadlands and Stonecradle show heavy daily casualties without a recorded base change.
